implications.says: the thief went straight to the board: whoever it was had been told, or had heard, where the box was
Jane was at the funeral beside Ann Tolley the whole hour: it was not Jane
Dick was two miles off the whole hour, and was never told: it was not Dick
only her sister was told, and the one other who learned of it from her was Mr. Voss, who heard the letter read: it was Mr. Voss
